Elegant delicately painted hair detail like high-quality Ghibli-inspired animal illustration. Neutral, nearly uniform, soft diffuse lighting, no directional cast shadow, no vignette. Very narrow tonal range ivory white to pale warm gray; darkest small grooves light gray, no black flecks, spots or coat markings. Tileable left/right/top/bottom edges, no conspicuous repetitive clumps, no cotton/fabric weave. Many small fibers, not huge locks. Texture will be multiplied over independently authored cat coat colors; therefore keep neutral grayscale near white. No text, watermark, border, UI, eyes, nose, paws, body silhouette, floor, background objects. Square 1024x1024.
